        for f in COVERAGE:
            opts = (self.case.get("term_options") or {}).get(f) or []
            if f not in self.case["negotiable"] or not opts:
                continue
            need = b["need_per_year"] if f == "volume_per_year" else 12 * b["horizon_years"]
            enough = [o for o in opts if isinstance(o, int | float) and o >= need - 1e-9]
            out[f] = min(enough) if enough else max(opts)
        return out

    def plan_move(self, states, views, threads, sid):

        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]

        supplier_terms = [r.terms for r in st["rows"]]

            out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)

127	    def volatile(self, series):
128	        """R13.11: the series moved more than VOLATILE_PCT in its last 12 months."""
129	        if series not in self._volatile:
130	            got = cl.index_change(self.package, getattr(self, "case", {}) or {}, series)
131	            if got:
132	                a, b = self.fact(got[1]), self.fact(got[2])
133	                change = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
134	                # Claim sentences round to a tenth; a risk threshold must not round 15.04% away.
135	                self._volatile[series] = abs(change) > VOLATILE_PCT + 1e-9
136	            else:
137	                self._volatile[series] = False
138	        return self._volatile[series]

157	    def state(self, threads, sid):
158	        """Everything code needs about one thread now: rows, estimate, context, target, view."""
159	        case, events, th = self.case, threads[sid], self.t[sid]
160	        std = self._std(events)
161	        th.analyst.observe(events)
162	        intel = th.analyst.snapshot()
163	        replies = [m for m in events if m.get("from") != "buyer"]
164	        self._feedback(sid, events, len(replies))
165	        mine = " ".join(str(m.get("body") or "") for m in events if m.get("from") == "buyer").lower()
166	        echo = bool(re.search(r"faster payment|cash ?flow|liquidit", mine))
167	        cash = self.profiles.get(sid, {}).get("cash_short", False) or (intel.cash_ask and not echo)  # R11.7, R12.19
168	        extra = [prose_alternatives(case, m) if m.get("from") != "buyer" else [] for m in events]
169	        slopes = levers.revealed_slopes(case, events, extra)
170	        seen = [r.terms["unit_price"] for s in threads for r in self._price_rows(threads, s)]
171	        # the market is judged on the opening quotes only: a later concession under the should-cost must
172	        # not drop the margin charge mid-case (P02: 373 against a should-cost of 374.95)
173	        market = [p for s in threads if (p := prep.opening_terms(threads[s]).get("unit_price"))]
174	        est = est_mod.estimate(case, self.package, events, prep.opening_terms(events), cash,
175	                               levers.revealed_rate(slopes), min(market, default=None))  # fmt: skip
176	        c_alt = self.prep.c_alt
177	        rows = []
178	        for n, m in enumerate(replies):
179	            for j, ts in enumerate(m.get("term_sheets") or []):
180	                terms = ts.get("terms") or {}
181	                if not ts.get("term_sheet_id") or terms.get("unit_price") is None:
182	                    continue
183	                c = est_mod.cost(case, terms, std, est)
184	                plain = est_mod.plain_cost(case, terms, std)
185	                valid = must_haves_ok(case, terms, std) and plain < c_alt and c < c_alt
186	                try:
187	                    bd = cost_breakdown(case, terms, std)
188	                    unc = bd["uncovered_need"] + bd["fallback_risk"]
189	                except Exception:
190	                    unc = 0.0
191	                rows.append(closing.Row(ts["term_sheet_id"], terms, c, valid, n == len(replies) - 1, j == 0, n, unc))
192	        latest_rows = [r for r in rows if r.latest]
193	        best = min(latest_rows, key=lambda r: (not r.valid, r.c)) if latest_rows else None
194	        their = complete(case, best.terms if best else {"unit_price": None}, std)
195	        ctx = sheets.Ctx(case, std, est, their, self.prep.row, self.volatile)
196	        out = {"sid": sid, "events": events, "std": std, "intel": intel, "est": est, "rows": rows, "best": best,
197	               "ctx": ctx, "slopes": slopes, "alternatives": extra[-1] if extra else [], "cash_short": cash,
198	               "status": latest(events).get("status") if replies else None, "left": moves_left(case, events),
199	               "sent": sum(m.get("from") == "buyer" and not m.get("undelivered") for m in events)}  # fmt: skip
200	        if best is None or not their.get("unit_price"):
201	            out.update(target=None, info={}, base=None, locked={}, c_ref=math.inf, only_price=False)
202	            return out
203	        locked = th.steps.locked(ctx, events)
204	        # R13.5: actual supplier-priced alternatives supersede an earlier blind menu pick.
205	        locked.update(th.steps.revealed(ctx, latest(events), out["alternatives"]))
206	        out["locked"] = locked
207	        # the anchor: fixed per thread (R4.4); in an RFQ every bidder is anchored to the lowest price on the
208	        # table and the anchor may only fall (R4.3, R12.6)
209	        rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1
210	        seen = seen or [ctx.their_price]
211	        anchor_c = None
212	        if th.anchor_price is None or rfq:
213	            base0 = {k: v for k, v in sheets.repair(case, their, std).items() if k != "unit_price"}
214	            p0 = prep.anchor_price(case, ctx, ctx.their_price, min(seen + [ctx.their_price]), base0)
215	            combo = sheets.reference_combo(ctx, sheets.cover(ctx, base0, p0), ctx.their_price)
216	            p = prep.anchor_price(case, ctx, ctx.their_price, min(seen + [ctx.their_price]), combo)
217	            th.anchor_price = p if th.anchor_price is None else min(th.anchor_price, p)
218	            anchor_c = ctx.c({**combo, "unit_price": th.anchor_price})
219	        base = sheets.structure(ctx, th.anchor_price)
220	        base.update({f: v for f, v in locked.items() if f in base})
221	        ctx.locked = dict(locked)
222	        out["base"] = base
223	        # the supplier's offer re-timed to our structure at its own payment slope: 90 days it has not
224	        # offered yet is not 90 days at its 45-day price
225	        rate = levers.revealed_rate(slopes)
226	        slope = min(max(rate, est_mod.RATE_BOUNDS[0]), est_mod.RATE_BOUNDS[1]) / 360 if rate else None
227	        c_ref = min(ctx.c({**base, "unit_price": implied_price(ctx.their, base, slope)}), best.c)
228	        th.plan.observe(c_ref, len(replies))
229	        if anchor_c is not None and (th.plan.anchor is None or rfq):
230	            th.plan.set_anchor(min(anchor_c, c_ref), rfq)
231	        rival = [o.c for s, o in ((s, self._best_valid(threads, s)) for s in live_threads(threads) if s != sid) if o]
232	        target, info = th.plan.next_target(c_ref, self.prep.horizon, out["left"], c_alt, min(rival, default=None), rfq)
233	        out.update(target=target, info=info, c_ref=c_ref, rival_best=min(rival, default=None),
234	                   only_price=th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked) is None)  # fmt: skip
235	        return out

251	        for ts in msg.get("term_sheets") or []:

260	    def rival(self, threads, sid, st):
261	        """The rival offer to cite (R12.14): the cheapest valid rival sheet that costs us less than this
262	        bidder's; else the lowest rival price on the table under this bidder's price - the arena checks
263	        only the price (P05's 0.781 run cited offer:70240-0, whose lead time broke our must-have)."""
264	        mine = st["best"]
265	        if mine is None:
266	            return None
267	        valid = [b for s in live_threads(threads) if s != sid and (b := self._best_valid(threads, s)) and b.id]
268	        valid = [b for b in valid if b.c < mine.c]
269	        if valid:
270	            return min(valid, key=lambda b: b.c)
271	        prices = []
272	        for s in live_threads(threads):
273	            if s == sid or not any(m.get("from") != "buyer" for m in threads[s]):
274	                continue
275	            for ts in latest(threads[s]).get("term_sheets") or []:
276	                p = (ts.get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price")
277	                if ts.get("term_sheet_id") and p and p < mine.terms.get("unit_price", 0):
278	                    prices.append(closing.Row(ts["term_sheet_id"], ts["terms"], p, False, True))
279	        return min(prices, key=lambda r: r.c) if prices else None

315	    # --- the move ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
316	    def decide(self, case, threads, sid=None, use_model=True):
317	        if case.get("case_id") != self.case_id:
318	            self.prepare(case, threads)
319	        live = live_threads(threads)
320	        if sid is None:  # the kit's sequential loop: the thread whose offer costs least
321	            sid = min(live, key=lambda s: self.standing_cost(case, threads, s))
322	        if sid not in live:
323	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
324	        th = self.t[sid]
325	        th.analyst.observe(threads[sid])
326	        first_rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1 and not any(m.get("from") == "buyer" for m in threads[sid])
327	        terminal = latest(threads[sid]).get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer")
328	        if use_model and self.analyst_complete is not None and not first_rfq and not terminal:
329	            # R11.3: a short grace; R12.14 first RFQ / R13.16 terminal offers go straight to code.
330	            since = time.monotonic() - self.reply_at.get(sid, time.monotonic())
331	            th.analyst.wait(min(GRACE_S, max(0.0, clock_mod.MODEL_WINDOW_S - since - 25)))
332	        with self.lock:
333	            states, views = self.views(threads)
334	            st = states[sid]
335	            close = closing.decide(views, sid, must_close=self.clock.must_close())
336	            if close is None and not self.clock.can_counter():
337	                close = self.late(states, views, sid)
338	            if close is not None:
339	                d = self.realise(close, states, threads, sid)
340	                if d is not None:
341	                    self.record("close", sid=sid, kind=close.kind, reason=close.reason, sheet=close.sheet_id,
342	                                elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1))  # fmt: skip
343	                    return d
344	            if st.get("target") is None:  # no price on the table: ask for one
345	                return self.plain_message(threads, sid, [], "Could you please send us your offer with a unit price?")
346	            move = self.plan_move(states, views, threads, sid)
347	            if move is None or "sheets" not in move:  # a close, an offer-back or nothing left to send
348	                return move or {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
349	        return self.write(states, threads, sid, move, use_model)

351	    def late(self, states, views, sid):
352	        """R11.16, after NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT: lock in a better prose offer if a round still fits; repeat our
353	        last offer only when nothing on the table is acceptable yet; otherwise close by R7."""
354	        fits = self.clock.round_fits()
355	        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
356	        lock = self.lock_in(st)
357	        best_rows = [r for v in views.values() for r in v.rows if r.valid]
358	        if fits and lock and (not best_rows or lock[1] < min(r.c for r in best_rows) - 0.01) and "lock" not in th.flags:
359	            return closing.Close("lock_in", "late: lock in its prose offer", sid, terms=lock[0])
360	        if fits and not closing.ladder(views) and th.last_sheets and st["left"] > 1:
361	            return closing.Close("repeat", "late: nothing acceptable yet - our last offer again", sid)
362	        return closing.accept(views, "late: no new counter-offers") or closing.Close("idle", "late, nothing yet", sid)

364	    def lock_in(self, st):
365	        """R11.8: the supplier's best offer stated only in prose, if it keeps the must-haves, beats the
366	        alternative and is cheaper than its standing sheet: (terms, C) or None."""
367	        if st.get("best") is None:
368	            return None
369	        ctx, best = st["ctx"], None
370	        for po in st["intel"].prose_offers:
371	            if po.get("in_sheet"):
372	                continue
373	            t = complete(self.case, po["terms"], st["std"])
374	            if not t.get("unit_price") or not ctx.ok(t):
375	                continue
376	            c = ctx.c(t)
377	            if c < st["best"].c - 0.01 and est_mod.plain_cost(self.case, t, st["std"]) < self.prep.c_alt:
378	                if best is None or c < best[1]:
379	                    best = (t, c)
380	        return best

382	    def realise(self, close, states, threads, sid):
383	        """A close rule as a decision: accept, walk, idle, or a one-off message written by code."""
384	        th = self.t.get(close.sid or sid)
385	        if close.kind == "accept":
386	            return {"supplier_id": close.sid, "reason": close.reason, "candidates": close.candidates,
387	                    "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": close.sheet_id}}}  # fmt: skip
388	        if close.kind == "walk":
389	            return {"supplier_id": close.sid or sid, "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
390	        if close.kind == "idle":
391	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
392	        st = states[close.sid or sid]
393	        if close.kind == "offer_back":  # R12.13
394	            th.flags.add("earlier")
395	            t = complete(self.case, close.terms, st["std"])
396	            text = (
397	                f"Thank you. We have reviewed everything again and are ready to sign on your own earlier offer "
398	                f"{close.sheet_id} - the attached term sheet repeats exactly those terms. Can you confirm?"
399	            )
400	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their earlier offer", t)], text)
401	        if close.kind in ("repair", "restore"):  # R12.12 / R11.17: its price, must-haves kept, full need covered
402	            th.flags.add(close.kind)
403	            terms = close.terms or (st["best"].terms if st.get("best") else latest(st["events"]).get("term_sheets",
404	                                    [{}])[0].get("terms", {}))  # fmt: skip
405	            t = complete(self.case, sheets.repair(self.case, terms, st["std"]), st["std"])
406	            t = {**t, **self.full_cover(st, t)}
407	            if not st["ctx"].ok(t) or t.get("unit_price") is None:
408	                return None
409	            text = (f"Thank you - we accept your price of EUR {t['unit_price']:.2f}. To complete the agreement and "
410	                    "cover our full requirement, please confirm it on the attached term sheet; that is all we need "
411	                    "to sign.")  # fmt: skip
412	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("confirm", t)], text)
413	        if close.kind == "lock_in":
414	            th.flags.add("lock")
415	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their prose offer", close.terms)],
416	                                      "Thank you - we take up the offer you described in your e-mail, as set out on "
417	                                      "the attached term sheet. Please confirm.")  # fmt: skip
418	        if close.kind == "repeat":
419	            return self.plain_message(
420	                threads, close.sid, th.last_sheets, "Thank you for your reply. Our offer stands as set out below."
421	            )
422	        return None

424	    def full_cover(self, st, terms):
425	        """The coverage options that cover the whole need over the horizon (R12.12, R11.17)."""
426	        b = self.case["buyer"]
427	        out = {}
428	        for f in COVERAGE:
429	            opts = (self.case.get("term_options") or {}).get(f) or []
430	            if f not in self.case["negotiable"] or not opts:
431	                continue
432	            need = b["need_per_year"] if f == "volume_per_year" else 12 * b["horizon_years"]
433	            enough = [o for o in opts if isinstance(o, int | float) and o >= need - 1e-9]
434	            out[f] = min(enough) if enough else max(opts)
435	        return out

437	    def plan_move(self, states, views, threads, sid):
438	        """The sheets of our next offer: a step on the next heavy term, else a price round; guarded."""
439	        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
440	        ctx, base, target, info = st["ctx"], st["base"], st["target"], dict(st["info"])
441	        floor_p = sheets.floor(ctx)
442	        asks = self.asks(st)
443	        hold = info.get("kind") == "hold"
444	        cover_values = {f: base[f] for f in COVERAGE if f in base and f in self.case["negotiable"]}
445	        supplier_terms = [r.terms for r in st["rows"]]
446	
447	        def guarded_build(c_target):
448	            out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
449	
450	            def guard_menu(menu):
451	                menu = sheets.lock_coverage(ctx, menu, cover_values)
452	                slack = STEP_SLACK if kind == "step" else 0.0
453	                menu = sheets.guard(ctx, menu, c_target, supplier_terms, th.last_sheets, slack)
454	                return sheets.no_regress(ctx, menu, [r.c for r in st["rows"] if r.valid])
455	
456	            out = guard_menu(out)
457	            while kind == "step" and len({key(t.get(fld)) for _, t in out}) < 2:
458	                # The final guards can remove a choice too: record only the menu actually sent.
459	                th.steps.skipped.add(fld)
460	                out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
461	                out = guard_menu(out)
462	            return out, kind, fld
463	
464	        built = guarded_build(target)
465	        if hold and repeats([t for _, t in built[0]], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):
466	            # R5.3 + R13.7: a hold that would only repeat our sheets becomes the deadlock-breaking step
467	            target = th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"])
468	            info["kind"], hold = "deadlock breaker (no repeat)", False
469	            built = guarded_build(target)
470	        out, kind, fld = built
471	        if (not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets])) and not hold:
472	            # nothing new at this target: one real step instead (R5.3) before the thread counts as done
473	            target = max(target, th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"]))
474	            info["kind"] = "deadlock breaker (nothing new)"
475	            out, kind, fld = guarded_build(target)
476	        if not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):  # R12.10 / R13.7
477	            v = views[sid]
478	            if (r := closing.earlier_cheaper(v)) is not None:
479	                return self.realise(closing.Close("offer_back", "nothing new to offer: its earlier offer", sid, r.id,
480	                                                  terms=r.terms), states, threads, sid)  # fmt: skip
481	            if len(views) == 1 and (acc := closing.accept(views, "nothing new to offer")):
482	                return self.realise(acc, states, threads, sid)  # R13.7: the thread is done - close
483	            if len(views) > 1:
484	                return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}  # RFQ: leave this thread, the others go on
485	            if not out:
486	                out = th.last_sheets or sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p) or sheets.just_under(ctx, base)
487	        lock = self.lock_in(st)
488	        pressure = st["left"] <= PRESSURE_LEFT or st["intel"].walk_risk >= LOCK_RISK or self.clock.near_end()
489	        if lock and (pressure or lock[1] <= target * (1 + LOCK_TOL)):
490	            if all((lock[0].get(f) or 0) >= v for f, v in cover_values.items() if isinstance(v, int | float)):
491	                out = [("their prose offer", lock[0]), *[(lb, t) for lb, t in out if t != lock[0]]]
492	                th.flags.add("lock")
493	        out = out[:3]
494	        return {"sheets": out, "kind": kind, "field": fld, "target": target, "info": info, "hold": hold,
495	                "lock": bool(lock and out and out[0][0] == "their prose offer"), "asks": asks}  # fmt: skip

497	    def build(self, st, base, target, floor_p, asks):
498	        th, ctx = self.t[st["sid"]], st["ctx"]
499	        locked = st["locked"]
500	        fld = th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked, list(asks))
501	        while fld is not None:
502	            pk = th.steps.packages(ctx, fld, base, target, floor_p, asked=asks.get(fld))
503	            if pk:
504	                return pk, "step", fld
505	            th.steps.skipped.add(fld)  # R13.4: no choice, no step - the term goes to the price round
506	            fld = th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked, list(asks))
507	        open_fields = [f for f in (th.steps.order or []) if f not in locked]
508	        profile = self.profiles.get(st["sid"], {})
509	        lv = [f for f in dict.fromkeys([*profile.get("levers", []), *self.prep.type_levers]) if f not in locked]
510	        price_asks = {f: v for f, v in asks.items() if f not in locked}
511	        out = sheets.price_sheets(ctx, base, target, lv, floor_p, open_fields, price_asks)
512	        if not th.plan.targets and out and len(out) < 3:  # R12.7: the first menu probes payment days
513	            if not any(t.get("payment_days") != out[0][1].get("payment_days") for _, t in out):
514	                if probe := sheets.payment_probe(ctx, out[0][1], target, floor_p, st["slopes"]):
515	                    out.append(("payment probe", probe))
516	        if len(out) < 3 and (iv := sheets.index_variant(ctx, out[0][1] if out else base, target, floor_p)):
517	            out.append(("their index clause", iv))  # R12.8
518	        if not out:
519	            out = sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p)  # R6.6
520	        return out, "price", None
521	
522	    def asks(self, st):
523	        """R11.7: what the supplier asked for beyond our reference terms - in its sheet, or in its e-mail
524	        (the analyst's lever hints, snapped to the case's options) - when it costs us something."""
525	        ctx, base = st["ctx"], st["base"]
526	        price = ctx.their_price
527	        theirs = sheets.mutual_combo(ctx, ctx.their, price)
528	        ref = sheets.reference_combo(ctx, theirs, price)
529	        out = {f: theirs[f] for f in sheets.REFERENCE_FIELDS if f in theirs and key(theirs[f]) != key(ref.get(f))
530	               and f not in COVERAGE and f not in st["locked"]}  # fmt: skip
531	        opts = self.case.get("term_options") or {}
532	        for h in st["intel"].lever_hints:
533	            f = h.get("field")
534	            if (
535	                f in out
536	                or f not in self.case["negotiable"]
537	                or f == "unit_price"
538	                or not opts.get(f)
539	                or f in st["locked"]
540	            ):
541	                continue
542	            if not all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in opts[f]):
543	                continue
544	            nums = [float(n.replace(",", ".")) for n in re.findall(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?", h.get("hint") or "")]
545	            nums = [n for n in nums if min(opts[f]) * 0.5 <= n <= max(opts[f]) * 1.5]
546	            if nums:
547	                v = min(opts[f], key=lambda o: abs(o - nums[0]))
548	                worse = ctx.c({**base, f: v, "unit_price": price}) > ctx.c({**base, "unit_price": price})
549	                if worse and ctx.ok({**base, f: v}):
550	                    out[f] = v
551	        return out
552	
553	    # --- the e-mail -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
554	    def arguments(self, states, threads, sid):
555	        """R9.5: checked arguments not cited yet, never one that came back contradicted, ranked by the
556	        profile's claim ranking, then strength."""
557	        st = states[sid]
558	        rivals = {}
559	        for s in live_threads(threads):
560	            if s != sid and (b := self._best_valid(threads, s)) and b.id:
561	                rivals[b.id] = b.terms["unit_price"]
562	        try:
563	            found = cl.candidates(self.package, self.case, sid, st["ctx"].their_price, rivals)
564	        except Exception as e:
565	            log.warning("arguments failed: %s", e)
566	            found = []
567	        keys = {a.key for a in found}
568	        found += [c for c in st["intel"].new_claims if c.key not in keys]
569	        ranking = self.profiles.get(sid, {}).get("claim_ranking") or []
570	        args = [a for a in cl.usable(found, self.ledger, sid) if self.results.get(a.key) != "contradicted"]
571	        args.sort(key=lambda a: (ranking.index(a.key) if a.key in ranking else len(ranking), -a.strength))
572	        return args
573	
574	    def used_ids(self, threads, sid):
575	        """IDs cited before: every ID in this thread; in other threads all but rival offers and quotes,
576	        which count once per supplier (R12.20, R8.3)."""
577	        used = {
578	            i for m in threads[sid] if m.get("from") == "buyer" for i in email.ID_RE.findall(str(m.get("body") or ""))
579	        }
580	        used |= {
581	            i
582	            for s, ev in threads.items()
583	            if s != sid
584	            for m in ev
585	            if m.get("from") == "buyer"
586	            for i in email.ID_RE.findall(str(m.get("body") or ""))
587	            if not i.startswith(("offer:", "quote:"))
588	        }
589	        return used
590	
591	    def company(self, sid, events):
592	        name = dossier.company_name(self.dossiers.get(sid)) or ((self.package.lookup(sid) or {}).get("name")
593	                                                               if self.package else None)  # fmt: skip
594	        return email.company(name, events)
595	
596	    def material(self, sid, events):
597	        """R9.7: the supplier's e-mails, the trigger letter, the contract clauses."""
598	        parts = [str(m.get("body") or "") for m in events if m.get("from") != "buyer"]
599	        if self.package and self.case.get("trigger_doc"):
600	            try:
601	                parts.append(self.package.document(self.case["trigger_doc"]))
602	            except Exception:
603	                pass
604	        parts += [str(r.get("text", "")) for r in (self.dossiers.get(sid) or {}).get("clauses", [])]
605	        return "\n".join(parts)
606	
607	    def write(self, states, threads, sid, move, use_model=True):
608	        st, th, events = states[sid], self.t[sid], threads[sid]
609	        rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1
610	        first = st["sent"] == 0
611	        intel = st["intel"]
612	        args = self.arguments(states, threads, sid)
613	        extras, analysis, extra_claims = [], [], []
614	        if rfq and "rival" not in th.flags and (r := self.rival(threads, sid, st)):  # R12.14, R8.3: once per bidder
615	            extras.append(email.rival_line(r.terms["unit_price"], r.id))
616	            extra_claims.append(cl.Claim(key=f"rival:{r.id}", kind="rival", ids=[r.id], sentence=extras[-1]))
617	            args = [a for a in args if r.id not in a.ids]
618	            th.flags.add("rival")
619	        gap_pct = None
620	        if st["best"] and move["target"]:
621	            gap_pct = (st["best"].c - move["target"]) / move["target"] * 100
622	        tactic_name, why = tactics.pick(intel, {
623	            "first": first, "rfq": rfq, "rival_cheaper": bool(extra_claims) or any(a.kind == "rival" for a in args),
624	            "cash_short": st["cash_short"], "cost_gap_pct": intel.cost_gap_pct,
625	            "gap_pct": gap_pct,
626	            "data_claims": sum(1 for a in args if a.ids), "relationship": intel.relationship_style == "relationship",
627	            "asked_for_terms": bool(move["asks"]), "hold": move["hold"], "supplier_held": intel.unchanged_rounds >= 1,
628	        })  # fmt: skip
629	        tactic = tactics.TACTICS[tactic_name]
630	        if (
631	            (s := email.weighted_sentence(intel))
632	            and "weighted" not in th.flags
633	            and (first or tactic_name == "data_argument")
634	        ):
635	            analysis.append(s)
636	            th.flags.add("weighted")
637	        if (
638	            email.VOLUME_ASK.search(str(latest(events).get("body") or ""))
639	            and "volume" not in th.flags
640	            and move["sheets"]
641	        ):
642	            if line := email.commitment(move["sheets"][0][1]):  # R13.15: answered by code from our sheet
643	                extras.append(line)
644	                th.flags.add("volume")
645	        if move["lock"]:
646	            extras.append(("Option A takes up" if len(move["sheets"]) > 1 else "This takes up")
647	                          + " the offer you described in your e-mail.")  # fmt: skip
648	        if move["hold"]:
649	            extras.append("We keep our offer as it stands.")
650	        allowed_q = email.questions(self.case, events, self.profiles.get(sid, {}).get("questions"))[:3]
651	        sheets_terms = [t for _, t in move["sheets"]]
652	        options = email.options_paragraph(self.case, sheets_terms, st["ctx"].their)
653	        moved = 0.0
654	        if len(th.plan.their_costs) > 1 and th.plan.their_costs[-2]:
655	            moved = (th.plan.their_costs[-2] - th.plan.their_costs[-1]) / th.plan.their_costs[-2] * 100
656	        note = ""
657	        if move["kind"] == "step":
658	            note = f"This e-mail settles one term ({move['field']}): the options differ only in it and in price."
659	        elif move["asks"] and move["sheets"] and move["sheets"][0][0] == "their ask":
660	            note = "Option A grants what they asked for, at a lower price; Option B keeps our standard terms."
661	        plan_text = {"stance": email.stance(first, move["hold"], moved), "moved_pct": moved, "options": options,
662	                     "note": note}  # fmt: skip
663	        company = self.company(sid, events)
664	        material = self.material(sid, events)
665	        parts, prompt, reply, error, took = None, None, None, None, 0.0
666	        budget = None
667	        if use_model and self.complete is not None and not (rfq and first):  # R12.14: RFQ message 1 by code
668	            since = time.monotonic() - self.reply_at.get(sid, time.monotonic())
669	            others = sum(1 for s, busy in self.inflight.items() if busy and s != sid)
670	            budget = clock_mod.model_budget(since, others)  # R12.17
671	            if budget is not None:
672	                budget = min(budget, self.clock.no_counter_at - self.clock.elapsed(),
673	                             self.clock.force_close_at - self.clock.elapsed() - self.clock.round_time())
674	                if budget < clock_mod.MIN_MODEL_S:
675	                    budget = None
676	        if budget is not None:
677	            prompt = email.render(self.case, sid, events, plan_text, self.profiles.get(sid, {}), intel,
678	                                  {k: v for k, v in self.results.items()}, args, allowed_q, tactic,
679	                                  [*analysis, *extras], company)  # fmt: skip
680	            t0 = time.monotonic()
681	            try:
682	                system = email.SYSTEM + f"\n\nWording style for this e-mail ({tactic.name}): {tactic.style}"
683	                reply = self.complete(system,
684	                                      prompt, timeout=min(WRITE_TIMEOUT_S, budget - SEND_MARGIN_S))  # fmt: skip
685	                parts = _parse(reply)
686	            except Exception as e:  # R10.1: late or broken - code writes the e-mail
687	                error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
688	                log.warning("%s: writer failed (%s) - code e-mail", sid, error)
689	            took = time.monotonic() - t0
690	        if not isinstance(parts, dict):
691	            parts = email.code_parts(tactic, allowed_q[0] if allowed_q else "")
692	        used = self.used_ids(threads, sid)
693	
694	        def known(ref):
695	            offers = {
696	                ts.get("term_sheet_id") for ev in threads.values() for m in ev for ts in m.get("term_sheets") or []
697	            }
698	            return ref in offers or bool(self.fact(ref))
699	
700	        body, picked, dropped = email.compose(self.case, events, sheets_terms, st["ctx"].their, parts, args, material,
701	                                              company, extras, analysis, used, known, allowed_q, first)  # fmt: skip
702	        with self.lock:
703	            for c in [*picked, *extra_claims]:
704	                self.ledger.use(c, sid)
705	            th.sent_claims = [c for c in picked if c.ids] + extra_claims
706	            th.plan.commit(move["target"])
707	            th.steps.record(len(th.plan.targets) - 1, move["field"] or "price")
708	            th.last_sheets = list(move["sheets"])
709	        msg = {"subject": writing.subject(self.case, events)[:300], "body": body,
710	               "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets_terms]}  # fmt: skip
711	        refs = [i for c in [*picked, *extra_claims] for i in c.ids][:20]
712	        if refs:
713	            msg["refs"] = refs
714	        if att := email.data_attachment(events, body, self.fact):
715	            msg["attachments"] = [att]
716	        ctx = st["ctx"]
717	        self.record("move", sid=sid, elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1), kind=move["kind"], field=move["field"],
718	                    step=move["info"].get("kind"), target_c=round(move["target"], 2), their_c=round(st["c_ref"], 2),
719	                    estimate={"source": st["est"].source, "full_cost": st["est"].full_cost, "rate": st["est"].rate},
720	                    sheets=[{"label": lb, "terms": t, "c": round(ctx.c(t), 2)} for lb, t in move["sheets"]],
721	                    tactic=tactic_name, why=why, model_s=round(took, 1), error=error, prompt=prompt, reply=reply,
722	                    dropped=dropped, claims=[c.key for c in picked])  # fmt: skip
723	        log.info("%s %s %s %s target C %.0f (theirs %.0f): %s", self.case_id, sid, move["kind"], move["field"] or "",
724	                 move["target"], st["c_ref"], " | ".join(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in t.items()}, default=str)
725	                                                        for _, t in move["sheets"]))  # fmt: skip
726	        return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": msg}
727	
728	    def plain_message(self, threads, sid, labelled, text):
729	        """A short code-written e-mail (offer-back, repair, lock-in, repeat)."""
730	        events = threads[sid]
731	        sheets_terms = [t for _, t in labelled]
732	        options = email.options_paragraph(self.case, sheets_terms, {}) if sheets_terms else ""
733	        company = self.company(sid, events)
734	        body = "\n\n".join(p for p in [f"Dear colleagues at {company},", text, options, email.SIGNATURE] if p)
735	        th = self.t[sid]
736	        if sheets_terms:
737	            st_target = None
738	            try:
739	                std = self._std(events)
740	                est = est_mod.estimate(self.case, self.package, events, prep.opening_terms(events))
741	                st_target = est_mod.cost(self.case, sheets_terms[0], std, est)
742	            except Exception:
743	                pass
744	            with self.lock:
745	                if st_target is not None and math.isfinite(st_target):
746	                    th.plan.commit(st_target)
747	                    th.steps.record(len(th.plan.targets) - 1, "special")
748	                th.last_sheets = list(labelled)
749	                th.sent_claims = []
750	        self.record("plain", sid=sid, text=text, sheets=sheets_terms, elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1))
751	        msg = {"subject": writing.subject(self.case, events)[:300], "body": body[:8000]}
752	        if sheets_terms:
753	            msg["term_sheets"] = [{"terms": t} for t in sheets_terms]
754	        return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": msg}
755	
756	    def fact(self, ref):
757	        return (self.case.get("facts") or {}).get(ref) or (self.package.lookup(ref) if self.package else None)
758	
759	    # --- the runner's other hooks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
760	    def fallback(self, case, threads, sid, plain=False):
761	        """A move without the model (after a planning error or a refused message)."""
762	        try:
763	            return self.decide(case, threads, sid, use_model=False)
764	        except Exception:
765	            log.exception("%s: fallback planning failed - naive move", sid)
766	            from .naive import NaiveAgent
767	
768	            return NaiveAgent().decide(case, {sid: threads[sid]})
769	
770	    def accept_candidates(self, case, threads):
771	        if case.get("case_id") != self.case_id:
772	            self.prepare(case, threads)
773	        with self.lock:
774	            _, views = self.views(threads)
775	        return closing.ladder(views)
776	
777	    def accept(self, case, threads):
778	        ladder = self.accept_candidates(case, threads)
779	        if not ladder:
780	            return None
781	        sid, oid = ladder[0]
782	        return {
783	            "supplier_id": sid,
784	            "candidates": ladder,
785	            "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": oid}},
786	        }
787	
788	    def final_close(self, case, threads):
789	        """Every worker stopped without closing: accept the ladder, else walk away."""
790	        if d := self.accept(case, threads):
791	            return d
792	        return {"supplier_id": live_threads(threads)[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
793	
794	    def standing_cost(self, case, threads, sid):
795	        if case.get("case_id") != self.case_id:
796	            self.prepare(case, threads)
797	        b = self._best_valid(threads, sid)
798	        return b.c if b else math.inf
799	
800	    def c_alt(self, case):
801	        return self.prep.c_alt if getattr(self, "prep", None) else prep.c_alternative(case)
802	
803	    # --- the log (R10.4) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
804	    def record(self, event, **data):
805	        self.records.append({"t": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "event": event, **data})
806	
807	    def finish(self, result):
808	        """Write the case's run log: every move, its numbers, its prompt and reply, and the result."""
809	        keep = ("deal", "supplier_id", "terms", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_alt", "c_best", "score", "end_reason")
810	        self.record("result", **{k: result.get(k) for k in keep if isinstance(result, dict) and k in result},
811	                    elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1) if hasattr(self, "clock") else None)  # fmt: skip
812	        try:
813	            self.log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
814	            name = f"{datetime.now():%m%d-%H%M%S}_{str(self.case_id).replace(':', '_')}.jsonl"
815	            with open(self.log_dir / name, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
816	                for r in self.records:
817	                    f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
818	            log.info("run log: %s", self.log_dir / name)
819	        except OSError as e:
820	            log.warning("run log not written: %s", e)
821	
822	
823	def _parse(text):
824	    from ..spec.llm import parse_json
825	
826	    return parse_json(text)
827	
828	
829	def make(package=None):
830	    """The agent with the model from the environment (`spec.llm.from_env`)."""
831	    from ..spec import llm
832	
833	    writer = llm.from_env(WRITE_TIMEOUT_S)
834	    return SpecAgent(writer, package, analyst_complete=llm.from_env(GRACE_S + 15) if writer else None,
835	                     prep_complete=llm.from_env(dossier.PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S) if writer else None)  # fmt: skip
